title: Italian general strike called for transport and public sectors
seoTitle: Rome transport and public sector general strike

tea.why: Workers are protesting to demand purchasing power recovery, actions against job insecurity, and defense of public services.
tea.want: Higher wages, a minimum wage of 12 euros per hour, lower working hours, and increased investments in public sectors.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Union groups outlined schedules and details for the upcoming December 4 general strike across public and private sectors.

summary: A nationwide general strike across public and private sectors has been formally called for December 4, 2026, with transport disruptions beginning as early as the evening of December 3. Organised by multiple union groups including SI Cobas, SGB, CUB, SGC, SBM, and ADL Varese, the mobilization targets transport, education, health, and other public and private services. Protesters demand purchasing power recovery, an end to precarity, stronger public services, increased funding for health and education, hiring of temporary school staff, and opposition to military spending. Authorities and operators have published operating windows and guaranteed service slots for trains, motorways, air travel, and local transit.
demands: Contribute against job insecurity and exploitation
Lower working hours with equal pay
A minimum wage of at least 12 euros per hour
Higher investments in healthcare, school, transport, and welfare
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Union organizations published details and timelines for the nationwide general strike planned for December 4.
